title.value: CADet: Fully Self-Supervised Anomaly Detection With Contrastive Learning
title.justification: The title directly indicates the development of a method for anomaly detection using contrastive learning, an area in machine learning that deals with handling out-of-distribution (OOD) samples.
title.quote: CADet: Fully Self-Supervised Anomaly Detection With Contrastive Learning

extractions.description: This paper presents CADet, a method for detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) samples using contrastive learning. It combines self-supervised learning with maximum mean discrepancy (MMD) testing to detect both unseen class and adversarial sample anomalies without the need for labeled OOD samples. The method outperforms existing adversarial detection approaches and functions effectively in unsupervised settings.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper does not explicitly address climate change topics, focusing instead on anomaly detection in machine learning, mainly in contexts like image classifications, adversarial attacks, and unseen classes.
climate_change_is_central.quote: Handling out-of-distribution (OOD) samples has become a major stake in the real-world deployment of machine learning systems...
